author: Stevie Bonifield
lede: A couple of Walmart's budget-friendly smart home cameras will be able to recognize people around your house now using Google's familiar face detection feature. A new Google Home update brings Familiar Faces support to the $35 Onn Outdoor Camera Plug-In and $77 Onn Floodlight Camera Hardwired. However, a Google Home Premium subscription is still required […]
title: Now Google’s Familiar Faces AI feature works on Walmart’s $35 smart home camera too
